Integrity-checked pilot has sufficient completed coverage and nonconstant game-level behavior. Repeatability estimates and sparse conditional support are retained; variation alone is not evidence of prediction.

Prespecified numerical predictors were scored against the ordered model/opponent baseline. All methods, missing support and paired uncertainty remain visible. The prompted-LLM comparison is still required.
Family, random-group and payoff interpolation/extrapolation holdouts completed. These are exploratory grouped validations; prospective forecasts and presentation/affine controls remain separate.

Focal/opponent identity ablations, held-out unordered pairings and zero-calibration model holdouts completed. Unknown identities use a declared fallback; no Gate8 adaptation or embeddings experiment was run.
Run the single fixed prospective cohort after positive screening or inconclusive retrospective evidence. No result-driven enlargement of this cohort is permitted.
